versions.changelog: Separate local image processing from the authenticated API client for a clearer security boundary; retain Bearer-only API Platform compression.
Remove the obsolete X-App-Key compatibility header; API Platform compression now uses only the declared PIXMIND_API_KEY Bearer credential.
Remove manual .env file parsing; rely on OpenClaw environment injection to eliminate credential-file access while retaining API Platform compression support.
Migrate image compression to /api-platform/v1/image/compress with Bearer authentication and Base64 local-file support.
Fix: default API base URL to production endpoint (aihub-admin.aimix.pro)
Initial release: cloud image compression and resize via Pixmind COS API
